name: Iron Inc.
description:
About This Game

BUILD YOUR FACTORY

Set up a basic factory on your first planet to facilitate research and rocket production for space exploration! Build easily with a ghost-marking system, where you can pre-plan your factory out before you have the resources to build everything. Belts are double-sided and you can distribute your items using splitters and underground belts. You use loaders and unloaders to load items to/from belts and buildings - multiple loaders/unloaders can be chained together to feed the same destination, allowing for very dense factory setups.

MIND YOUR NEIGHBORS

Sometimes the locals on yours planets don't take too kindly to all the pollution and automation happening there. Fortunately, you have defenses at your disposal to fend off the attacks. Once you're ready, you can also produce your own troops from barracks and use them to attack the spawners. Eradicating all enemy nests will stop all future attack waves on that planet.

COLONIZE MORE PLANETS

Boil some water and you can go to space! Deployer rockets can be used to colonize new planets, after which you'll gain a clone of yourself on every planet you colonize to instantly switch between. Each galaxy has hundreds of planets you can (and eventually need) to set up base on, and you'll need better rockets to venture further than your home system.

INTER PLANETARY LOGISTICS

Different planets have different natural resources. Extract and ship these resources between manufacturing hubs on various planets to build a conglomeration of inter-planet logistics.

PILOT YOUR FLEET

Produce and manage hundreds of ships to do your bidding across planets both friendly and hostile. All ships have expendable fuel and ammo - you need to maintain proper logistics and refueling stops, unless you want to frequently send rockets to bail out your stranded ships.

BUILD BEAUTIFUL FACTORIES

Sometimes it's a vibe to just observe your factory at work. Just make sure you don't stare for too long and get attacked or run out of ore!
short_desc: Iron Inc is an interplanetary factory automation game where you colonize, build, and fight on planets across the galaxy while developing inter-planetary logistics systems. Create massive bases and engage in combat on the ground and in space.
